sentences.en: I won't be able to go travelling until the requisite visa fees are paid.
sentences.zh: 直到缴纳了必要的签证费用，我才能出去旅行。

sentences.en: The car had the requisite tail fins that you would expect from that era.
sentences.zh: 这辆车配有那个年代应有的尾鳍。

sentences.en: All the requisite documents were submitted before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 会议前提交了所有必需的文件。

senses.zh: 必需品：something necessary；必不可少的，必备的：necessary

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re+quis（寻求）+ite→反复寻求的→必要的
